title: Awesome 80s Songs Released in February
author: Admin
excerpt: Let’s take a musical trip back to the 1980s with some hits that were released in February and became classics!
content:
The 1980s gave us some unforgettable music that people still love today! Here are a few great songs that were released in the month of February and went on to become big hits.

  • "Don't You (Forget About Me)" by Simple Minds
    Released on February 20, 1985, this song became one of the most iconic 80s anthems after being featured in the movie The Breakfast Club. Its catchy chorus makes it instantly recognizable! 🎧
  • "Rhythm of the Night" by DeBarge
    This dance‑pop hit was released on February 23, 1985 and quickly became a favorite on radio stations and at parties thanks to its fun, upbeat rhythm. 💃
  • "Jessie’s Girl" by Rick Springfield
    Released in February 1981, this pop‑rock classic about unrequited love became a major hit and is still loved by fans of 80s music today. 🎸

These songs show how the 80s brought music that was full of emotion, dance‑worthy beats, and unforgettable hooks. Try listening to them with your friends or family and see which one becomes your favorite! 🎶
